title: Vacuum charged-particle pole threshold at fixed scalar MSbar matching
scope: New scalars only, flat-space vacuum, one loop, original matching. No graviton/SM loops, finite-Q determinant, soliton quantum energy or lifetime.
units: v(mu0)=1; s is the positive timelike invariant, p_E squared=-s

integrals.tadpole: delta_v=-dV1/dphi / Mphi². Derive directly from four tree mass derivatives at vacuum. No finite tadpole counterterm is fitted.
integrals.curvature_crosscheck: Same formula at s=0 must equal previous strict effective-potential X curvature squared. Pole-minus-curvature=-g3²[B0(b)-B0(0)]/(16*pi²).

checks.quadrature: Adaptive quad at epsabs=epsrel=1e-12, compared to independent Gauss-Legendre n=32,64,128,256. Absolute B0 difference<1e-11.
checks.tadpole_and_curvature: Independent direct integral reconstruction must agree with prior tadpole and strict curvature within1e-14 v³/v².
checks.below_cut: At s=b and the resulting pole, Feynman denominator has positive minimum; cut threshold=(sqrt(a)+sqrt(b))². No imaginary scalar self-energy at this pole.
checks.derivative: Analytic dB0/ds integral checked against central differences at steps1e-4,3e-5,1e-5,3e-6; best relative difference<1e-7.
checks.RG_scale: Run all ten coefficients from mu0 with the previously verified one-loop betas, mu/mu0=1/2,1,2. Derive the tree vacuum and tadpole at each scale. Residual variation of one-loop pole is an order diagnostic, not a two-loop error bound.
checks.strict_vs_implicit: Report strict evaluation at s=b and separately the numerical root of the truncated one-loop inverse propagator. Their difference contains induced higher-order terms, not a two-loop calculation.

comparison_rule: The pole is a quantum vacuum threshold. Comparing it to an uncorrected classical E or Omega does not demonstrate a consistently quantum binding margin. Use it as an input for the as-yet uncomputed fixed-Q quantum energy.
vacuum_gravity: Keep the raw scalar vacuum constant matching; relative subtraction and the tadpole shift do not impose a gravitational zero vacuum density.
